title.en: Metadata Basics and Actions in Lightroom Classic
title.zh-cn: Lightroom Classic 元数据基础与操作

purpose.en: Learn to inspect and edit metadata, and consider GPS privacy when sharing.
purpose.zh-cn: 学习查看和编辑元数据，并在分享时考虑 GPS 隐私。

editorialNote.en: Editable metadata is evidence with limitations, not cryptographic proof of shooting conditions.
editorialNote.zh-cn: 可编辑的元数据是有局限的证据，不是拍摄条件的密码学证明。

verification.evidence: The documentation covers metadata inspection and editing and location-data privacy considerations.
